title: The item text on 'the king's reverse die' ('wants the obverse to be struck true; Hann's own hand cut this one') never updates after the obverse die was found and both dies were used together to strike the penny at Pennywell's vault-door — the description still reads as an open want in every inventory listing for the rest of the ~230-turn run afterward.
where: carried-items list, any status after t395 (die found) / t395 (dies struck)
